title: REQ · Worker writes structured JSON logs at a configured level
summary: Logger factory returns a slog JSON logger honoring a level string
description: Context: backend uses slog.NewJSONHandler inline in cmd/server/main.go; the worker needs a reusable factory. Desired behavior: logging.New(w, level) returns a JSON slog logger. Expected result: parseable log lines filtered by level. Why: execution reports need structured logs.
acceptance_criteria: Given level info, when Info is logged, then one JSON line with msg and level INFO is written
Given level warn, when Info is logged, then nothing is written
Given an unknown level string, when New runs, then it returns an error
